ir.spec_origin: The date of final dose (from the CRF) is EX.EXENDTC on the subject's last EX record. If the date of final dose is missing for the subject and the subject discontinued after visit 3, use the date of discontinuation as the date of last dose. Convert the date to a SAS date.
ir.rationale: Conditional fallback to discontinuation date (with DS/visit-3 logic) is ambiguous and requires human-only decisions on which records and source variables to use.
